title: Can You Identify All 50 US States by Outline? (Easy to Impossible)
description:
Can you name all 50 US states from their outline alone? 5 levels, from Easy to Impossible: three clues and a countdown for each state, then see exactly where it is on the map. Comment your rank below 👇

CHAPTERS
0:00 Level I - Easy
1:34 Level II - Medium
3:02 Level III - Hard
4:46 Level IV - Very Hard
6:34 Level V - Impossible
8:32 Your rank

ANSWERS (spoilers)
Level I (Easy): Maine, Louisiana, Texas, California, Alaska, Florida, Oklahoma, Michigan, Hawaii, New York
Level II (Medium): Ohio, Idaho, Washington, Georgia, Massachusetts, Maryland, Minnesota, Virginia, Illinois, Nevada
Level III (Hard): South Carolina, New Mexico, Arizona, Pennsylvania, Oregon, Missouri, Tennessee, West Virginia, North Carolina, Kentucky
Level IV (Very Hard): Iowa, Mississippi, Wisconsin, Delaware, Connecticut, Utah, Arkansas, Indiana, Alabama, New Jersey
Level V (Impossible): Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Colorado, Wyoming, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, Kansas, Vermont, South Dakota

Every frame is drawn by code over open data (no AI images). Questions are fact-checked against Wikipedia. Map data: Natural Earth (public domain).

A new expedition every day: subscribe to The Lost Atlas.
